add_library(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system_port INTERFACE)
add_library(hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}system_port ALIAS hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system_port)
target_include_directories(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system_port INTERFACE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/port
)
target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system_port INTERFACE proj::options)

if(NOT HC32_PORTABLE)
    add_library(hc32_time_port INTERFACE)
    add_library(hc32::millis_task_port ALIAS hc32_time_port)
    target_include_directories(hc32_time_port INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
    target_link_libraries(hc32_time_port INTERFACE hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system_port)
    add_library(hc32_easylogger_port INTERFACE)
    add_library(hc32::easylogger_port ALIAS hc32_easylogger_port)
    target_link_libraries(hc32_easylogger_port INTERFACE hc32::millis_task_port hc32::segger_rtt)
    file(GLOB SYSTEM_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS *.c *.cpp)
elseif(PORTABLE_CLOCK)
    set(SYSTEM_SOURCES delay.c)
elseif(PORTABLE_HEAP)
    set(SYSTEM_SOURCES Syscalls_GCC.c)
endif()
add_library(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system OBJECT ${SYSTEM_SOURCES})
add_library(hc32::${HC32_PREFIX}system ALIAS hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system)
target_include_directories(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system PUBLIC ${HC32_PORT} hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system_port)
if(NOT HC32_PORTABLE OR PORTABLE_HEAP)
    target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system PUBLIC hc32::segger_rtt)
endif()
if(NOT HC32_PORTABLE)
    target_link_libraries(hc32_${HC32_PREFIX}system PUBLIC hc32::ddl hc32::easylogger)
endif()
